title: Mobile haptic feedback & modular architecture
summary: Introduces tactile haptic feedback across mobile and PWA touch interactions, alongside a full modernization of the core library into clean, modular domain packages.

changes.text: Cross-platform mobile haptic feedback: crisp tactile micro-pulses (12–15ms) when switching tabs in ScannerTabs, PillTabs, PillNav, and GlassSegmentedControl.
Tactile review interactions: light and medium haptic responses when confirming, editing, or deleting equipment cards in the Scan Review modal.
Multi-tier haptic driver engine: automatic selection between Web Vibration API, iOS WebKit switch fallback, and silent desktop fallback, respecting prefers-reduced-motion.
Modular lib architecture: reorganized shared utilities into domain-focused modules (good/, scanner/, hooks/, materials/, stats/, seo/, server/, storage/, versions/).
Unified React hooks package: all motion and animation hooks consolidated under @/lib/hooks for cleaner imports and tree-shaking.
